# Snowfield & Jordan Masopust

> Applied AI implementation, custom multi-model workflows, and operational enablement built inside accounts you own.

## Studio Overview

Snowfield is a remote, nationwide applied AI implementation studio founded by Jordan Masopust, serving established US businesses and remote product or operations teams. Before building anything, Snowfield finds where the operation's documents disagree, such as old price sheets, side-channel messages, and rules that live in one person's head, and settles the current rules. Then Snowfield builds custom assistants on Claude, Gemini, and OpenAI with Python and React, and have a second model from a different company review them, so tools say when they do not know instead of inventing an answer.

Every prompt, GitHub repository, and guide lives directly inside accounts the client already owns, paired with live team onboarding so staff can update rules without calling an agency.

## Current Capabilities

- **Custom Assistants:** Assistants that answer from the client's own documents, use Claude, Gemini, or OpenAI as each job requires, and pass the question to a person when the documents are silent.
- **Clean Source Documents:** Playbook audits, Knowledge-Centered Service (KCS) practices, and one current set of rules.
- **Onboarding and Training Apps:** Interactive onboarding, training, and live-call web apps built in React and Python for non-technical staff working under pressure.
- **Independent Review:** A second model from a different company checks every change, with audit trails, before it reaches staff.

## Founder Track Record (Jordan Masopust)

Firsthand operational builds. Hands-on with language models since GPT-3 in July 2020.

- **Regulated Lending Workflow Assistant:** Built a loan-officer assistant across Claude and Gemini that refuses rather than guesses when guidance is missing, with a setup guide and a rollout proposal that corporate IT adapted company-wide.
- **High-Volume B2B Sales Enablement:** Built a multi-model discovery and objection copilot while on a high-volume business-to-business sales team, alongside a repeatable live-transfer process adopted at the director level.
- **Enterprise Restaurant Point-of-Sale Support & Knowledge-Centered Service:** Team lead on a 24/7 enterprise restaurant point-of-sale support team of more than fifty agents serving over a thousand restaurant concepts. Audited more than half of the knowledge base and turned recurring engineering fixes into standard troubleshooting playbooks. Built a structured case-dispatching workflow alongside Dynamics 365 and Jira to speed first replies and cut repeat callbacks.

## Technical Stack

Claude, Gemini, OpenAI, AI-assisted Python and React web apps, Dynamics 365, Jira, and Knowledge-Centered Service (KCS).
